They both work fine, and either would be okay with me. If I have to choose, I'll go with the three-dot menu approach. My reasoning is that I imagine, over time, there'll be more things I'll want to do to a bookmark than just edit it — and having a tidy little menu for those keeps the list itself clean and easy to read, which matters a lot to me when I'm scanning through everything. A row cluttered with buttons would work against that.

So let's go with the menu. Just make sure clicking the title still opens the actual webpage the way it does now.
